actions.detail: -22.9% on cost (price Rs 63.56). ROE/ROIC are now BELOW the 11.5% risk-free rate -- the earning power no longer clears the bar a quality holding should. Despite this, CPHL trades at the richest P/E of the three pharma holdings (18.5x vs SEARL 11.3x, GLAXO 9.5x) -- the market isn't pricing the deterioration in. The REIT demerger (transferring ~31 kanal of Lahore property into Citi Core Holdings) was approved by shareholders (99.99% in favour, Jul 2026) but Lahore High Court final sanction is still pending with no confirmed timeline -- real but unquantifiable optionality, not a reason to hold through continued earnings decline. One down year with a weakening balance sheet, priced at a premium multiple, is enough to trim -- not yet the multi-quarter break that would justify a full EXIT. PRICE UPDATE (Oct15, intraday): Rs63.00 (-25.3% on cost). TRIM call unchanged.
actions.target: Trim ~5,000 of the 10,000 shares at market (~Rs 63.6) -- proceeds ~Rs 318K, split ~55% into GLAXO (~Rs 175K, the stronger-quality pharma peer from this review) and ~45% into MZNPETF (~Rs 143K, standing dry-powder target).
